note: Runtime-loaded image/stock-photo URL patterns. Used by the stock-photo demotion fix so that stock-photo / image-library results arriving through the GENERAL web result set (e.g. a pinterest.com or pixabay.com URL returned by SearXNG) are recognized as image sources and demoted for non-image queries. Structural allow-list of platforms the engine treats as 'image surfaces', not a per-query tuned list — same approach as AUDIO_HOSTS / VIDEO_HOSTS.
